description.zh: 老韩自研的 DeepSeek Harness 插件集，统一通过插件市场安装与更新。
description.en: Self-built DeepSeek Harness plugins by Hanwu, installed and updated via the plugin market.
Use the models included with the Loomy desktop app in DSH with no configuration. Shows a composer credit pill and a model-rate popover, with a settings card for credits and the model list.
description.zh: 把 Loomy 桌面 App 包含的模型直接接入 DSH，开箱即用。输入框显示 Loomy 积分胶囊与模型倍率弹层，设置卡片可查看积分与模型清单。

description.en: One wide popup for all connected platforms: horizontal provider tabs, frequency-pinned favorites, cross-provider search, and one-click session model switching. Independent of connector plugins, so connector upgrades cannot change its UI.
description.zh: 一个宽弹窗集中所有已连接平台的模型：横排标签切换、按使用频率置顶常用、跨连接搜索、点击即切换会话模型。独立于各连接器插件，连接器升级不影响界面。

description.en: Platform and project level long-term memory. Injects two compiled memory nodes into every session, gives the model memory write/read tools, and re-compiles raw notes into structured memory on demand from the plugin details page.
description.zh: 平台级与项目级长期记忆。向每个会话注入两个编译后的记忆节点，提供模型记忆读写工具，并可在插件详情页一键将原始记录二次编译为结构化记忆。

description.en: Adds a button under the composer that rewrites the prompt currently in it. Click once to fix grammar, ambiguity, and structure while keeping your intent and length; double-click to rewrite the rough text into a structured prompt with an explicit goal, context, requirements, and expected output. The result replaces the draft in place, and an Undo appears for a few seconds so a bad rewrite costs one click. Polishing uses the model you have selected in the session, and each click is one model request. Nothing is saved: the Host appends no session event and stores no draft. Turning the plugin off removes the button.
description.zh: 在输入框下方加一个按钮，点击后重写输入框里正在写的提示词。单击轻修：修正语病、歧义与结构，保留你的原意和大体长度；双击重写：把口语化的描述改写成结构化提示词，明确目标、背景、要求与期望输出。结果直接替换输入框内容，并出现「撤销」按钮保留几秒，改坏了点一下就还原。润色使用你在会话里选中的那个模型，每点一次就是一次模型请求。不保存任何东西：Host 不写会话事件，也不存草稿。关闭本插件即移除该按钮。

description.en: A sidebar-footer entry that opens a floating panel listing the current credit balance of every connected platform: Trae (CN), WorkBuddy, Qoder (CN), Qoder (Global) and Loomy; Doubao Work has no readable balance route yet and shows a placeholder row. Every number is read from the owning plugin's own read-only route; nothing is written.
description.zh: 左下角一个「积分」入口，点开浮窗汇总各已接入平台的当前积分余额：Trae 国内、WorkBuddy、Qoder 国内、Qoder 国际、Loomy；豆包工作暂无可读余额接口，占位显示。数据全部来自各插件自身的只读路由，不写任何配置。
